_envelope: All creates take {"data": [ {type, attributes} ]} EXCEPT create_signup_field_values, which is hybrid (student_id top-level + data). Attribute-level detail is also in specs/skilljar-v2-openapi.json; what is captured here is what the spec does NOT say.
_batch_convention: 200 all succeed | 207 any fail | 400 empty envelope or over BATCH_MAX_ITEMS. Per-item error vocabulary lives in api_v2/docs/batch-responses.md, which is NOT public - it must be learned empirically.
_CRITICAL_422_BOUNDARY: Per-item isolation applies only AFTER the envelope is parsed. Any schema-level validation error - a malformed field or a cross-field invariant violation - is raised by Pydantic BEFORE the handler runs and rejects the WHOLE request with a document-level 422. Only service-layer failures inside the loop are isolated per item. Get this wrong and one bad row in a batch of fifty silently becomes 'nothing was written'.

attributes.title: string, REQUIRED, 1..500
attributes.created_by_email: email|null - resolved to an active OrganizationMembership in the caller's org; null leaves created_by null

create_courses.dedup: NONE - Course has no natural uniqueness key.

create_lessons._XOR_RULES: HTML -> content_html required and non-empty; MODULAR -> content_items required, lesson-level content_html FORBIDDEN; QUIZ -> quiz_id required, both content_html and content_items FORBIDDEN. The schema Literal is the single reviewable gate; the service layer is permissive.

content_item.id: string|null - PRESENT = update existing child, OMITTED = create new (the diff key)
content_item._constraint: Capped at 15 items; at most one QUIZ and one RATING. A foreign field for the type is a 422.

rating_config.rating_scale: enum[5,10]|null - a PROXY for course-level Course.rating_scale, not a block column. The 10-point capability is gated in the service.

create_quizzes.note: Quiz has no parent FK, so there is no per-item not_found on create. A cross-field invariant violation (check_quiz_cross_field_rules) on ANY single item rejects the whole request with 422.

create_question_banks.note: No parent FK, so no per-item not_found on create.

attributes.answers: array - MUST be empty for FREEFORM; >= 1 for all other types
attributes.correct_answer_feedback_html: string, default "" - NOT allowed for FREEFORM
attributes.incorrect_answer_feedback_html: string, default "" - NOT allowed for FREEFORM
attributes.case_sensitive: boolean, default false - only valid for FILL_IN_THE_BLANK
attributes.requires_manual_grading: boolean, default false - NOT allowed on MC/MA/FITB

create_questions._XOR: quiz_id XOR question_bank_id. Both -> 422. Neither -> 422. This is why the scope is OR.
create_questions._NOT_ACCEPTED: Question `order` and per-answer `order` are NOT accepted - the service auto-assigns question order and answer order (idx*10 by array position). `is_graded`, `is_optional` and `answer_feedback_html` are NOT writable on create (they take Question model defaults); extra=forbid turns an attempt into a 422 rather than a silent drop.
create_questions._QUIRK: `correct` is accepted for every type for a uniform wire shape, but the service FORCES it True for FILL_IN_THE_BLANK regardless of what was sent.
create_questions._UNSUPPORTED_TYPES: CONTENT_UPLOAD and LINEAR_SCALE exist in the model but are rejected with 422 - the Literal is the API-enabled subset.

attributes.email: string(email), REQUIRED - normalized to lowercase on save

create_students.dedup: first-wins on email; later occurrences pre-marked duplicate_in_batch without reaching the service

attributes.name: string, REQUIRED, 1..100 - UNIQUE within the organization, CASE-SENSITIVE
attributes.category_id: string|null, max 64 - must belong to the same org or the item fails with not_found
attributes.rule_email_domains: array[string] - bare domains (e.g. example.com) that auto-add students on signup; duplicates collapsed

attributes.content_url: string, REQUIRED - https:// URL of the package archive
attributes.title: string, REQUIRED, 1..500

create_web_packages._ASYNCHRONOUS: The server fetches and re-hosts the archive ASYNCHRONOUSLY. The response describes rows in state=PROCESSING; poll GET /v2/web-packages/{id} until state is READY or ERROR. A malformed archive surfaces as state=ERROR, NOT as an error on the create response. Any tool description that omits this will mislead a model into reporting success.
create_web_packages._RATE_LIMIT: Rate limited more tightly than a plain row-writing batch endpoint - each accepted item queues an outbound fetch of up to REMOTE_FETCH_MAX_BYTES, converting one request into real egress. Concurrency additionally bounded by Celery workers.
create_web_packages._url_validation: The https/well-formed check is SYNTACTIC ONLY at schema-parse time (422). Authoritative network safety runs at fetch time in the worker.
create_web_packages.dedup: NONE - two identical content_url values are a legitimate request for two distinct packages.

create_signup_field_values._envelope: HYBRID - student_id at the top level, per-field items in data.
create_signup_field_values.semantics: UPSERT - existing values are overwritten. 200/207/400, plus 404 if the student is unknown or has no memberships in the organization.
create_signup_field_values._naming: Called create_* but it is create-or-update.
